scope: Proposition 4.3 (Uniformity over exterior typings) of the manuscript “Metric-measure limits of subcritical FK and spanning-tree planar maps” (preprints/Metric-measure-limits-of-subcritical-FK-and-spanning-tree-planar-maps-September-24-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 211 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 1dd659698d3a3fde), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 18. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix bF ∈ (0, 1/2). Let νbF be the law on C([0, 1], R2) of Brownian motion started from zero with covariance matrix at time t equal to t 2 1 − bF bF bF 1 − bF ! . For the bounded-Lipschitz distance associated with the uniform ℓ1 path metric, sup σ dBL  L(m−1/2 Zσ (m ·)), νbF  −→ 0, (4.9) where σ ranges over all possibly randomized, word-dependent exterior typings. The convergence holds conditionally, uniformly over previously observed data which leave the block fresh and iid. A fixed finite family of deterministic disjoint blocks, whose lengths each tend to infinity, converges jointly to independent Brownian paths after applying the respective square-root normalizations.
